# cryptoki 0.12.1: standard DSA mechanism identifiers

Source: crates.io cryptoki 0.12.1, upstream git ae5285f13458f16aa1b83491bd4db00cf332820c, path cryptoki. The original .crate SHA-256 is 625cf4599c43d69a16996ce2573fc80745a0b0300c962f0bfa11d55b6cab2b2d. Retain all 57 original package files, including LICENSE (Apache-2.0), copyright headers, Cargo.toml, Cargo.toml.orig, README.md, examples/tests and .cargo_vcs_info.json. Do not substitute Cargo.toml.orig: its original sibling cryptoki-sys path is inappropriate for this standalone copy; the published normalized Cargo.toml already uses registry cryptoki-sys 0.5.0.

Only src/mechanism/mod.rs is modified: six named constants and six TryFrom match arms for CKM_DSA and DSA_SHA1/SHA224/SHA256/SHA384/SHA512. Its header records this modification. Cryptoki-sys already supplies the standard numeric constants. The existing safe generic parameter wrapper handles these parameterless standard mechanisms. No new unsafe code, cryptographic implementation, FFI invocation, dependency version, mechanism enum variant or permissive raw-number constructor is added. Existing Display names already cover all six values. The DSA key-generation and DSA-SHA3 mechanisms remain outside this patch.

Use root [patch.crates-io] and exclude vendor/cryptoki from workspace membership. Root owns the regenerated Cargo.lock; cryptoki's registry source/checksum are expected to disappear from its lock entry, while version 0.12.1 and its dependency versions remain fixed. Remove this patch when the selected upstream release has the equivalent safe mappings. No upstream issue or submission is claimed here.
